constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['created'::text, 'redirected'::text, 'claimed'::text])) AND completed_at IS NULL OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['exchanged'::text, 'denied'::text, 'expired'::text, 'invalidated'::text, 'failed'::text])) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: oauth_transaction_pkce_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (pkce_required AND pkce_challenge ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$'::text OR NOT pkce_required AND pkce_challenge IS NULL)

constraints.name: oauth_transaction_provider_pkce
